renal_belief_state.interpretation: The explicit online-compatible predict-update belief state is partially validated: useful for BUN and 24h urine output, not yet for creatinine.

renal_belief_state_v2.interpretation: Adding a creatinine-specific level/slope/innovation state fixes the prior explicit state's creatinine gap and creates the current best online-compatible renal belief candidate.

coagulopathy_heme.interpretation: Heme/coag is no longer just a platelet/WBC proxy: hemoglobin and hematocrit select ridge_realfit in 7/7 splits, INR has partial signal, and transfusion evidence includes volume/dose-observed intakeOutput rows.

gate.pass_rule: candidate must significantly beat both baseline and capacity-matched placebo on downstream observable targets

heme_coag_belief.interpretation: Bleeding/coagulation reserve beliefs show partial hemoglobin/hematocrit signal, but no target reaches robust 7/7 placebo-gated validation and hospital-heldout does not pass.

long_horizon.interpretation: 24h strengthens hemoglobin/hematocrit factual routing, but 48h weakens heme lab source selection and coagulation cascade targets remain persistence at both horizons.

transfusion_subtype_depth.interpretation: Blood-product subtype and dose observability is non-empty and strengthens 24h Hgb/Hct belief signal, but no target passes the 7/7 placebo-gated promotion boundary and coagulation cascade targets remain locked.
transfusion_subtype_depth.next_step: Need stronger unit semantics, protocol/bleeding/procedure context, anticoagulation reversal evidence, or external identified transfusion data; do not relax the gate.

respiratory_failure.interpretation: A narrow respiratory/ARDS/ventilator-coded eICU module validates the same factual router pattern; oxygenation, respiratory-rate, perfusion, heart-rate, pH, and most bicarbonate splits select ridge_realfit.

chapter_b_multi_disease.next_engineering_step: Body-system breadth is closed. Heme transfusion subtype/dose depth was tested and remains candidate-only; next depth work should add stronger context/observability or move to another validated belief-state target rather than adding disease names.

templates.cohort_definition: suspected infection plus organ dysfunction or SepsisLabel, with hourly vitals/labs and treatment timing
notes: Start as factual router using PhysioNet/eICU/MIMIC trajectories.
Do not claim antibiotic or fluid causal effects from observational EHR.
templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: KDIGO-like creatinine or urine-output change with medication and hemodynamic context

templates.cohort_definition: ARDS / ventilator-coded respiratory failure or severe measured hypoxemia with respiratory vitals, oxygenation, acid-base, and observed respiratory treatment evidence
